event_flow_diagram.step: 1. User clicks button element in browser
2. Svelte on:click directive triggers handleClick function
3. handleClick checks if disabled/loading and prevents action if needed
4. handleClick calls onclick prop if provided (backward compatibility)
5. handleClick dispatches 'click' event for on:click usage
6. Parent component receives event and executes appropriate action
